package.description: A radial pie menu for Windows. Hold a key, flick toward a slice, release.

en-US.description: A radial pie menu for Windows. Hold a key, flick toward a slice, release.
en-US.longDescription:
RadialDeck opens a ring of actions around the cursor from a hotkey or a mouse button.
Rings can follow the foreground app, read the Explorer selection and the clipboard,
launch programs, send keys, run commands and paste text. It ships with 1,270+ recipes and can control OBS Studio.
en-US.name: RadialDeck
en-US.releaseNotes:
Changed
- A Pro key from radialdeck.com runs on two PCs at a time. On a third PC it says so and that PC stays Free; removing the key in RadialDeck on one of the others (Settings, License, Remove) frees its place at once, and a PC not used for 90 days frees its place on its own. Nothing is blocked while offline. radialdeck.com counts the PCs by a one-way code made from Windows' machine id, which says nothing about you; the privacy policy says so.
- The 14-day Pro trial starts once per PC: radialdeck.com remembers the day it started on that PC (by the same code), so reinstalling RadialDeck no longer starts it again.

Fixed
- The Streaming, Video files and Drawing tablet packs asked for Win+Alt+T, Win+Alt+M and Win+Alt+Y, which Windows' Game Bar and other common programs already use, so on most PCs they fell back to another shortcut with a "taken" note. They now use Win+Alt+Shift+T, Win+Alt+Shift+M and Win+Alt+Shift+Y.
SHA-256 of RadialDeck-0.16.1-Setup.exe: A9E11BC4F404F47FE83E26A66A7D9E7C6E68E80CA30A241F1746CF1011F644FE
